opening: Lord, meet us gently today and always
body: I heard a priest say today that our minds are powerful. At first I thought he was speaking about positive thinking, but I think he was pointing to something much deeper. We spend our lives believing our thoughts, our fears, our interpretations, and our assumptions. Yet Isaiah simply says, “Come to me… listen, that you may have life.” Maybe life begins when I stop believing every thought that enters my mind and instead allow God to fill it with His truth. A renewed mind sees through Christ instead of through fear. The circumstances may not change, but the way I see them does. If I let Him shape my mind, then my words, my actions, and my heart naturally begin to reflect Him. We become instruments, not because we try harder, but because we begin to see with His eyes.
